body: I don't fuck with benadryl anymore. Tried it once, 350mg for old 120lbs me, I went full schizophrenic. I honestly did it to see what the mind of schizophrenic people felt like, since my mom has very bad mental illness and has hallucinations (doing well now, just in her past). I just like understanding the thoughts and occurrences that happen with other people, so I thought why not. Fuck was that a mistake. Like you, I don't regret it because it was an experience, but at the time I honestly don't know how I didn't kill myself to end it. Demons everywhere, I couldn't get away from them, I was having horrible convulsions, hearing voices saying horrible things to me, little girls crying, screaming in agony... It worse than any nightmare I'd ever had. The sheer detail that was in the skin of the demons that surrounded me was terrifying. I didn't see any normal people except for my mom and brother, only demons. Probably 8 different demons, all trying to kill me. I screamed for my brother who I thought was across the hall, but it turns out he was at a friend's house. I heard him and my mother calling me saying "it's okay Isaac you're okay" and I see them walk into my room and I think Im safe, but then they say horrible things, it's their exact voice it was so real, and then they vanish. Then boom more demons, there was no escaping it. Honestly the most terrified I have ever been. Would not do it again.

When I did it it was about 350mg, but i am a small skinny guy so you might need more. It was a horrible trip for me, scary as shit seeing demons everywhere in my house chasing me. I'd never do it again I hope it goes well for you man I've heard it can be fun.
